requirements.title: Policies, processes, procedures, and practices … are in place, transparent, and implemented effectively.
Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented.
Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems …
Policies and procedures … define and differentiate roles and responsibilities for human-AI configurations and oversight of AI systems.
AI system security and resilience … are evaluated and documented.
Risks associated with transparency and accountability … are examined and documented.
Privacy risk of the AI system … is examined and documented.
Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place.
Strategies to maximize AI benefits and minimize negative impacts are planned, prepared, implemented, documented, and informed by input from relevant AI actors.
Mechanisms are in place … to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems …
AI risks and benefits from third-party entities are managed.
Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented …
Incidents and errors are communicated to relevant AI actors … processes for tracking, responding to, and recovering from incidents … are followed and documented.
